description: Apple's on-device engines for Settings > Plugins (plugins/apple-ml): Vision reads the text of a picture, VisionKit's document camera scans a page on iOS, and SpeechAnalyzer turns a recording into text (speech_install has the OS download a language's model from Apple). All of them take and give bytes in memory, never a file. The page calls them: a Web Worker has no Tauri IPC. macOS and iOS only; every other platform's app has no such plugin. Spec: docs/internal/plans/plugins.md (section 6.7).
